description: This file contains the AutoMobileShaderSwitch class used in Unity to switch shaders on renderers for mobile platforms, along with related nested classes for defining shader replacements, and an editor drawer for customizing the replacement list in the Unity editor.

classes.name: AutoMobileShaderSwitch
classes.description: Main class responsible for replacing shaders on Renderer components on mobile platforms.

classes.name: AutoMobileShaderSwitch.ReplacementDefinition
classes.description: Defines a shader replacement pairing original shader with a replacement shader.

classes.name: AutoMobileShaderSwitch.ReplacementList
classes.description: Contains a list of ReplacementDefinition objects for batch shader replacement.

methods.name: OnEnable
methods.description: Triggered on object enable; performs shader replacements based on the platform, replacing shaders in renderers with specified replacements.
